chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Muawiya ibn Ammar, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: When you intend to exit from the city, perform ghusl, then go to the grave of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) after you have finished with your needs, and do as you did upon your entry.

And say: 'O Allah, do not make it the last visitation of the grave of Your Prophet. If You cause me to die before that, then I testify in my death upon what I testified upon in my life that there is no god except You, and that Muhammad is Your servant and Your Messenger.'

key_terms.الْمَدِينَةِ: The city (specifically Medina in this context)

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and ritual when leaving Medina after visiting the Prophet's grave?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the spiritual significance of treating the Prophet's grave as a final point of departure, emphasizing ritual purity (ghusl) and the continuity of faith from life to death. It reflects the Shia tradition of viewing ziyarah not merely as a visit but as a covenantal relationship, where the believer seeks to ensure their final breath aligns with the testimony of the Prophet's prophethood.
